name: Aram
line: Aram was the highland region northeast of Israel toward the Euphrates, later led by Damascus, and it is where Jacob fled and where David won a victory.

moments.title: Balaam brought from Aram
moments.text: Balaam says King Balak brought him from Aram to curse Israel. Balaam answers that he cannot curse those whom God has not cursed.

moments.title: David rules Aram of Damascus
moments.text: David puts soldiers in camps in Aram of Damascus. The Arameans become his servants and bring him payments, and the LORD makes David victorious wherever he goes.

moments.title: Absalom's claim about a vow
moments.text: Absalom tells David he made a promise to the LORD while living in Geshur of Aram. He uses this promise as his reason to go to Hebron.

moments.title: Jacob flees to Aram
moments.text: Hosea recalls that Jacob fled to the land of Aram. There Israel worked for a wife and tended sheep for her.
